hints.content: We have two tapes that are the same length. Let's start by writing an expression for the length of each tape.
The top tape has a length of $19$ units.

The bottom tape has two parts, one with a length of $16$ units and the other with a length of $f$ units.

The total length of the bottom tape is $16+f$ units.

So, the tape diagram shows us $19=16+f$.

The section labeled $f$ is $16$ units shorter than the $19$ unit long tape.

$f=19-16=?$
